title_s: Ternary Residue Mixing and Natural Density Descent for the Collatz Map

comparison.source_conductor: section 2 defines n-v_3(xi), the exponent, not the modulus 3^n
comparison.same_law: equations (7)-(10), geometric independent valuation word and uniform lift
comparison.proved_rate: Theorem 5.2, equation (63): for every A>0 an O_A(q^(-A)) full L1 estimate; H=1 gives the unweighted law
comparison.target_rate: There exist C,c>0 with full L1 distance <= C exp(-c m), uniformly 1<=m<=n
comparison.distinction: No exponential dependence on m is asserted by Theorem 5.2; constants depend on A with no uniform control supplying exponential decay. Sections 4 and 5 only prove faster-than-polynomial decay in the conductor exponent.
comparison.formalization_scope: section 9 explicitly assumes phase decay, mixing and integer comparison; it does not provide an unconditional Lean proof of these analytic estimates.
comparison.disposition: C14 overlap hold resolved; exact target remains stronger than the retrieved theorem.
